question: If the repaired Shared Row Model Tournament is mechanically activation-ready, is prospective collection of C01-C07 scientifically worth activating, and what would constitute genuine incremental decision information rather than redundant correlated signals?

Define the minimum prospective evidence needed to compare singles, pairs and C07 without multiple-testing self-deception.
Evaluate whether the non-overlapping 28-day block design is statistically useful or only governance/accountability scaffolding.
Specify simple baselines that must beat or change decisions relative to C01-C07 before any claim of incremental information.
Define the correct unit of independence for repeated hourly/daily rows so sample size is not overstated.
Define false-positive and false-negative costs for permission/block decisions without converting research outputs into portfolio advice.
Determine whether prospective collection has positive expected information value despite no current canonical authority.
Rank which optional families, if any, deserve future admission only after core evidence exists. Do not invent data or unblock a family.
Identify kill criteria for the entire tournament if correlated candidate outputs add no information beyond the simplest frozen baseline.
Return what must remain UNKNOWN until prospective outcomes mature.
